description: This file defines functions, types, and macros related to UTF-8 encoding handling in a C project, including string processing, encoding detection, and BOM handling.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for display mode.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Returns the width of a UTF-8 character sequence.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string with a specified length and skips ANSI sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if the given string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding name refers to UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Determines if two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE stream with UTF-8 considerations.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the UTF-8 BOM in a byte stream if present.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text to a strbuf with specified indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data to a strbuf with specified indentation and width.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns a UTF-8 string within a strbuf according to specified alignment and width.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a BOM is improperly used in UTF-16BE/LE or UTF-32 data.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a required BOM is missing in a UTF-16/32 data stream.

methods.name: reencode_string_iconv
methods.description: Re-encodes a string using iconv.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_len(const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
methods.description: Re-encodes a string specifying input and output encodings.

methods.name: char * reencode_string(const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
methods.description: Re-encodes a string from in_encoding to out_encoding.

methods.name: mbs_chrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a multibyte character given text and encoding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if the path matches '.git' after case-folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if the path matches '.gitmodules'.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if the path matches '.gitignore'.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if the path matches '.gitattributes'.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if the path matches '.mailmap'.

ctags.name: reencode_string
ctags.signature: (const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
